iso898_1.standard: ISO 898-1 property classes of steel bolts and screws: class, minimum tensile strength Rm and minimum 0.2 % proof strength Rp0.2 in MPa (8.8 for d up to 16 mm)
iso898_1.source: TR Fastenings knowledge base, 'Steel screws and bolts ISO 898-1 EN 20898-1, mechanical properties', trfastenings.com/knowledge-base/metric-screws/screws-and-bolts-mechanical-properties (read 2026-11-27)

c45_normalized.standard: C45 (1.0503) normalized (+N) to EN 10083-2: section band (t_lo, t_hi] in mm, minimum tensile strength Rm and minimum yield ReH in MPa
c45_normalized.source: Applus Laboratories materials portal, datasheet C45 / 1.0503 (citing DIN EN 10083-2:1996), appluslaboratories.com/materials-portal/datasheet/c45-1-0503 (read 2026-11-27); the 2006 edition was not read

clamp_basis.standard: ASSUMED clamp-joint factors, not read from a standard: thread friction mu_G 0.12 and head friction mu_K 0.12 (lightly oiled steel screws), clamp-to-shaft friction mu 0.10 (low end for steel on steel), torque-wrench scatter alpha_A 1.6, assembly utilisation nu 0.9 of the proof strength
clamp_basis.source: assumed values, labelled in every result; the preload and torque formulas are the textbook combined-stress and thread-torque relations
